data.description:
## Description

**What**: Final wiring step — `.github/workflows/ci.yml` passes `OPENAI_API_KEY` alongside `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`; mocked-curl integration test exercises the full pipeline under `model.provider=openai`; boundary preservation of local Anthropic-specific keys is verified; OpenAI default model IDs are validated against the live OpenAI model list.
**Why**: Closes the user-visible deliverable — a consumer can switch providers via config and CI review runs end-to-end against the chosen provider.
**Scope**:
- IN: ci.yml env block update; OpenAI-path integration test; boundary diff verification; OpenAI default model ID verification against the OpenAI API; silent-removal verification for DSO_LLM_MODEL with migration note; pre-merge OPENAI_API_KEY secret-presence check
- OUT: Helper changes (P2-S1); runner refactor (P2-S2); changes to `enrich-file-impact.sh`, `semantic-conflict-check.py`, `resolve-model-id.sh`, `check-model-id-lint.sh`, the four model-config tests, or `model.haiku/sonnet/opus` keys (out of epic scope)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` passes `OPENAI_API_KEY` from secrets to the llm-review job env block alongside `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
  ← Satisfies: "OpenAI provider path produces schema-conformant output"
- When this story is complete, with `model.provider=openai` + OpenAI default keys + `OPENAI_API_KEY` set, a mocked-curl integration test produces a `reviewer-findings.json` that passes the same JSON schema as the Anthropic path with all 5 dimension scores populated
  ← Satisfies: "OpenAI provider path produces schema-conformant output"
- When this story is complete, the OpenAI default model IDs (`gpt-5.4-nano`, `gpt-5.4`, `gpt-5.5`) have been verified against OpenAI's official model list (e.g., `curl https://api.openai.com/v1/models` with `OPENAI_API_KEY`); if any default ID does not appear in the live model list, the defaults are updated to verified IDs before the story closes; the verification result is recorded as a story comment
  ← Satisfies: "OpenAI provider path produces schema-conformant output"
- When this story is complete, the silent removal of `DSO_LLM_MODEL` is verified by a test — setting `DSO_LLM_MODEL=some-bogus-id` in the runner environment must not change the model used (config-driven model wins) — and a user-facing migration note is added to `CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` (or CHANGELOG) explaining that `DSO_LLM_MODEL` is now ignored, with guidance to use `model.{light,standard,deep}`; a805-b0e2 explicitly references this migration note
  ← Satisfies: "Runner refactored to delegate"
- When this story is complete, `model.haiku`, `model.sonnet`, `model.opus` and their consumers (`enrich-file-impact.sh`, `semantic-conflict-check.py`, `resolve-model-id.sh`, `check-model-id-lint.sh`, `tests/scripts/test-model-config-integration.sh`, `tests/scripts/test-model-id-lint.sh`, `tests/scripts/test-resolve-model-id.sh`, `tests/scripts/test_semantic_conflict_check.py`) are byte-unchanged across the Phase 2 extension — verified by `git diff <Phase-2-baseline>...HEAD -- <those-paths>` returning empty at story close
  ← Satisfies: "Local Anthropic-specific keys boundary preserved"
- When this story is complete, `OPENAI_API_KEY` presence in GitHub Actions secrets has been confirmed via `gh secret list` at the relevant repo (or org) scope before merge; if missing, the story cannot close and a parent action item is opened to provision it
  ← Satisfies: "OpenAI provider path produces schema-conformant output"
- unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] OpenAI deep-tier 4-call burst may hit rate limits on Tier 1/2 OpenAI accounts; failure mode should be observable in CI logs and tests
- [Security] `OPENAI_API_KEY` secret must be configured in GitHub Actions secrets before the runner is dispatched against OpenAI; fail-closed if missing
- [Hygiene] Per Always Do These rule 10, OpenAI default model IDs must be verified against OpenAI's authoritative model list (the API or official docs) — not training-data assumptions — before this story ships
- [Testing] f731-3fa0 (host-project E2E) is downstream-blocked on this story and must be updated to (a) source both `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `OPENAI_API_KEY` from secrets, (b) exercise the review pipeline under at least one OpenAI configuration in addition to the existing Anthropic one, (c) gracefully skip OpenAI-path assertions if `OPENAI_API_KEY` is unavailable in the host project context (warn rather than silent-skip)

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a CI maintainer, I can set model.provider=openai in dso-config.conf and CI review runs successfully against OpenAI
